parameters.name: App
parameters.description: The name of the application to which the stream belongs.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time, and the time span cannot exceed 10 hours. If you do not specify StartTime and EndTime, data for the last hour is queried by default. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard. Use UTC.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard. Use UTC.
